data: Synthetic only; same-generating-family engineering evaluation, not clinical evidence.
protocol: Patient-seeded held-out cohort; one session per patient; windows at 60,90,120,150,180 min; endpoint minimum latent synthetic SBP over next 30 min; current low estimates excluded. Repeated windows are correlated.
limitations: Generator and model share fluid-balance assumptions
Synthetic priors supplied rather than fitted to real records
No confidence intervals; repeated windows are correlated
No prospective workflow or clinical outcome measurements
